'''Bianca's Minccino''' (Japanese: '''ベルのチラーミィ''' ''Bel's Chillarmy'') is the first Pokémon {{pkmn2|caught}} by {{an|Bianca}} in the wild, and her second overall.

==In animation==
===History===
Bianca's Minccino first appeared in ''[[BW013|Minccino—Neat and Tidy!]]'', where he stole a [[Badge]] case that Bianca was delivering to {{Ash}}, in order to clean it. Bianca, thinking that Minccino was extremely cute, sent out her {{TP|Bianca|Pignite}} to {{pkmn|battle}} him in the hopes of capturing him. He was able to dodge some of Pignite's powerful moves and used {{m|Hyper Voice}} and {{m|Tickle}}, and Pignite had to be returned. Ash was about to send his Pikachu to battle the Minccino when {{AP|Oshawott}} came out of his {{i|Poké Ball}} to battle him instead. Minccino dodged Oshawott's {{m|Tackle}} and evaded his {{m|Razor Shell}} before defeating him with a combination of Tickle and {{m|Double Slap}}. He then proceeded to run away, with Ash's Badge case in tow.
[[File:Bianca and Minccino.png|thumb|left|250px|Minccino and Bianca]]
Bianca then tried tempting Minccino with a cloche and a dirty spoon that she "borrowed" from {{an|Cilan}} which seemed to work, but Minccino just carried the cloche away, much to Cilan's dismay. They found where Minccino was hiding and Ash sent out {{AP|Snivy}}, who used {{m|Attract}}, but Minccino used Attract back, forcing Ash to recall Snivy. This also confirmed that Minccino was male, as his Attract worked on Snivy, who was female. {{AP|Pikachu}} battled last, and the pair seemed to be equally matched. Minccino used his Tickle-Hyper Voice combination, but Pikachu used {{m|Thunderbolt}}, which dazed Minccino. Bianca then managed to catch him when he attempted to clean her dirty Poké Ball.

Bianca called upon Minccino's help in ''[[BW024|Emolga the Irresistible!]]'' where she wished to catch an {{TP|Iris|Emolga}}. He seemed to be gaining the upper hand when Emolga suddenly attacked with {{m|Discharge}}. Both Pokémon used {{m|Attract}} on each other and the two attacks clashed until Emolga's pushed through. He would have been affected by it but {{AP|Oshawott}} jumped in the way and took the hit for him. In ''[[BW025|Emolga and the New Volt Switch!]]'', he battled the same Emolga which was now under the ownership of Iris. When he was gaining the upper hand, she used {{m|Volt Switch}} and swapped places with [[Cilan's Pansage]] who was in the middle of taking a nap in his Poké Ball. He was angered when he was hit by Minccino's {{m|Hyper Voice}} and knocked him out with a single {{m|Solar Beam}}.
[[File:Elesa Zebstrika Flame Charge.png|thumb|right|250px|Minccino struggling against Elesa's Zebstrika]]
In ''[[BW040|Cilan Versus Trip, Ash Versus Georgia!]]'', Bianca used Minccino in the [[Club Battle]] tournament. He went up against [[Stephan]]'s {{p|Zebstrika}}. Despite putting up a good fight, he was defeated by a powerful {{m|Stomp}} attack, knocking Bianca out of the tournament.

Bianca used Minccino against [[Elesa]] for her [[Gym]] battle in ''[[BW049|Enter Elesa, Electrifying Gym Leader!]]''. Like {{p|Shelmet}} before him, Minccino was quickly defeated by Elesa's {{p|Zebstrika}}, even with his newly learned {{m|Swift}} attack.

Minccino was revealed to have learned Thunderbolt in ''[[BW062|Crisis at Chargestone Cave!]]''. Bianca ordered him to use his new move on a tree to lure a group of wild {{p|Galvantula}} away and to use Swift, which knocked some Oran berries out of the tree and onto the Galvantula, knocking them out briefly. Minccino and Pikachu were soon wrapped up by Galvantula's {{m|String Shot}} and taken from their Trainers to Galvantula and {{p|Joltik}}'s nest. The two Pokémon were told that the Joltik needed to absorb electricity in order to built up their strength, so they both helped them out by using Thunderbolt on them. Later, Minccino joined [[Cilan's Crustle|Cilan's Dwebble]], [[Iris's Excadrill]] and Pikachu in battling {{TRT}}.

===Personality and characteristics===
[[File:Bianca Minccino cleaning.png|thumb|left|250px|Minccino cleaning with his tail]]
[[File:BW013.png|250px|thumb|Minccino being lured into a trap by a dirty spoon]]
Like many Minccino, Bianca's Minccino has a thing for cleanliness. He will take things that do not belong to him in order to make them clean. He himself also doesn't like to be dirty and will clean himself off with his tail if he does.

Minccino can also be considerate of other Pokémon, as seen in ''[[BW062|Crisis at Chargestone Cave!]]'' where he played with a group of {{p|Joltik}} and also helped nourish them with his {{m|Thunderbolt}}'s electricity.
{{-}}
